tasks.title: BBC 6 Minute English · Learning from different generations (ep-261122)

tasks.prompt: One timed take: a time the requirements were unclear (STAR #3). Point → reason → example. Recite from memory first, then check 📜. If you still have a minute, run one recall set (e.g. why-this-role) from memory without flipping.
tasks.script:
Point: My task was to build a defensible evidence base, even though the requirements were unclear.
Reason: First, I pushed for a working definition of what counts as an AI data centre, so the whole analysis shared one scope. Second, I mapped the data gaps — I counted which indicators Hong Kong was missing and compared them with other regions. Because the direction kept shifting, I built an iterative workflow, and after every meeting I kept a written log of what we agreed.
Example: As a result, I delivered a baseline analysis of data-centre governance, plus a clear list of the data Hong Kong is still missing.
